title: Analitik Historis & SLA Jaringan Kampus (7 Hari, WIB)

panels.title: Tren Ketersediaan SLA Harian per Gedung (% Waktu Patuh)

targets.rawSql: SELECT (f.date_wib::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS time, b.building_id AS metric, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.is_sla_compliant THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS value FROM warehouse.fact_sla_window f JOIN warehouse.dim_building b ON f.building_key = b.building_key GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Gedung Paling Bermasalah Selama 7 Hari Terakhir (Peringkat SLA & Alert)

targets.rawSql: WITH alert_counts AS (SELECT building_key, COUNT(*) AS total_alert FROM warehouse.fact_alert GROUP BY building_key) SELECT b.building_id AS kode_gedung, b.building_name AS nama_gedung, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT f.is_sla_compliant) AS window_melanggar, (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT f.is_sla_compliant) * 5) AS durasi_menit, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT f.is_sla_compliant) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_melanggar, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.is_sla_compliant THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS sla_patuh_pct, COALESCE(a.total_alert, 0) AS total_alert, ROUND(AVG(f.p95_latency_ms)::numeric, 2) AS rata_p95_ms FROM warehouse.fact_sla_window f JOIN warehouse.dim_building b ON f.building_key = b.building_key LEFT JOIN alert_counts a ON a.building_key = b.building_key GROUP BY b.building_id, b.building_name, a.total_alert ORDER BY window_melanggar DESC, total_alert DESC, rata_p95_ms DESC

panels.title: Rata-Rata Trafik Masuk per Jam per Gedung (Mbps — BLD-RECT Core 10 Gbps)

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.full_timestamp_utc AS time, b.building_id AS metric, AVG(f.avg_port_in_mbps) AS value FROM warehouse.fact_device_metric_hourly f JOIN warehouse.dim_time t ON f.time_key = t.time_key JOIN warehouse.dim_building b ON f.building_key = b.building_key WHERE f.avg_port_in_mbps IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Kualitas Data: Disisipkan vs Tertangkap (Ledger Rekonsiliasi)

targets.rawSql: SELECT anomaly_type AS jenis_data_kotor, disisipkan_count AS disisipkan, tertangkap_count AS tertangkap, ditangani_count AS ditangani, capture_rate_pct AS persentase_tertangkap FROM warehouse.dq_reconciliation ORDER BY run_timestamp_utc DESC, anomaly_type LIMIT 5
